description: Permanently deletes ONE of the caller's own YAFL transfers, identified by `id` (a bare transfer id or a full share URL — the fragment/key, if present, is never read). This cannot be undone: the R2 object is purged and the transfer record is removed. Destructive action.

id.description: A YAFL transfer id, or a full share URL, e.g. https://yafl.dev/t/{id}#{key}

name: delete_file
title: Delete File
